breakdown.description: The prompt substitutes the bending second moment I for the polar moment J in torsion formulas, even though solid circular shaft torsion is governed by J = π d^4/32.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification correctly uses the torsional polar moment J = π d^4/32 and applies it in both τ_max = T(d/2)/J and φ = TL/(JG). It does not repeat the incorrect instruction to use bending moment I in torsion relations, matching the ground truth intent.
